item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 23/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong and the central and northern parts of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. An area of low pressure may develop over the broad trough of low pressure, and bring unsettled weather to the vicinity of Luzon. Meanwhile, the tropical cyclone to the east of Luzon Strait will move in the general direction of the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands, and move into the East China Sea in the latter part of this week. Winds are expected to be weak and it will be very hot during the day apart from isolated showers over Guangdong towards the weekend. A southwesterly airstream will affect the coastal areas early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Wipha will move across Laos and dissipate gradually today.
